purpose: Report the small-addition model on the 222-person evaluation data, replacing a development-data statement in the paper.
origin: Reviewer suggestion, requested by the user. Post-hoc: the 222 people were already used for the large-addition comparison.
arm: matched-normal100 adult arm: 9 LJMU adults, 12 records, 12 windows, about 1% of training weight, calibration on Stanford training data only.
comparison: Baseline versus small addition on 222 people and 377 records, then the existing large addition with measured-value calibration as context.
fusion: Existing fixed fold weights from ensemble.json, unchanged.
metrics: Same as 20261106-final222-normal100: person-averaged MAE and bias for all, ge90, ge100, lt70; paired person bootstrap 10000, seed 20261106.
reporting_rule: Reported whatever the direction. The arm is not chosen after seeing the result; the child arm is not evaluated.
